decision: Retain the pinned pfQuest baseline at the user's explicit direction; GPL and MIT are acceptable. Remove all Wowhead-derived overrides. Include both known license notices and document the unresolved base-dump rights. This is not complete legal clearance.

findings: items.lua and refloot.lua last changed at the February 2025 database update, which explicitly names the VMaNGOS revision below. quests.lua also received an August 2025 exclusive-group update.
The pinned extractor reads required item IDs from quest_template, NPC loot from creature_loot_template and shared sources from reference_loot_template.
No localized strings, coordinates or drop rates are retained in VanillaVarnish's projection. An ID-only projection does not itself prove exemption from upstream rights.
The workflow imports world_full_14_june_2021.7z from brotalnia/database, applies core SQL migrations, then exports a database snapshot.
The license text supplies GPL v2 terms. A repository license does not establish rights to every record imported from a separate archive.
No express permission to relicense upstream-covered database material as MIT was established. Preserve the GPL terms instead of claiming MIT covers all upstream material.
Repository root listing contains database archives, with no top-level LICENSE or README. GitHub's repository metadata reports license=null.
This does not prove the archives are unlicensed. Notices within the compressed archive have not been inspected, and contributor rights have not been established.
No new database dump was downloaded or imported for this review.

interpretation.finding: An extractor's license does not automatically determine the rights in converted input data. Adding a GPL notice cannot resolve missing permission in an upstream input.

before_future_imports: Verify the exact input revisions and applicable permissions before collection or redistribution.
Obtain or inspect an explicit base-dump grant covering redistribution of quest/item/NPC relationships, and identify any required contributor notices.
Clarify upstream-covered data terms before representing the baseline as fully cleared. Do not assume that relicensing all addon code resolves a separate input-permission gap.
